verdict.rationale: Twenty documents workspace data export for backups or migration and explicitly promises 'export your data anytime — no lock-in' (twenty-docs-29, twenty-docs-9, twenty-docs-38). REST and GraphQL APIs cover every object, including custom ones, so data can also be pulled out programmatically (twenty-docs-8, twenty-docs-22). Self-hosting via Docker Compose lets you own the data end to end (twenty-docs-10, twenty-docs-44). The core of 'export and leave' is covered, but UI exports are capped at 20,000 records per export. Missing for 10: an explicitly stated open export file format (e.g. CSV/JSON), a documented full-workspace export path without the 20k record cap, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a complete exit migration.
